lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਾੜੀ ਹੈ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aape jaanai kare aap jin vaaRee hai laaee ||1||
lines.translation: He Himself knows, and He Himself acts; He laid out the garden of the world. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਇਸਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਾ ਰਾਇਸਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raaisaa piaare kaa raaisaa jit sadaa sukh hoee || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Savor the story, the story of the Beloved Lord, which brings a lasting peace. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਸਾ ਪਛੋ ਰੇ ਤਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin ra(n)g ka(n)t na raaviaa saa pachho re taanee ||
lines.translation: She who does not enjoy the Love of her Husband Lord, shall come to regret and repent in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਪਛੋੜੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਧੁਣੈ ਜਬ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: haath pachhoRai sir dhunai jab rain vihaanee ||2||
lines.translation: She wrings her hands, and bangs her head, when the night of her life has passed away. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਛੋਤਾਵਾ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਬ ਚੂਕੈਗੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pachhotaavaa naa milai jab chookaigee saaree ||
lines.translation: Nothing comes from repentance, when the game is already finished.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਵੀਐ ਜਬ ਆਵੈਗੀ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: taa phir piaaraa raaveeai jab aavaigee vaaree ||3||
lines.translation: She shall have the opportunity to enjoy her Beloved, only when her turn comes again. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੰਤੁ ਲੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੈ ਤੇ ਵਧਵੀ ਏਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: ka(n)t leeaa sohaaganee mai te vadhavee eh ||
lines.translation: The happy soul-bride attains her Husband Lord - she is so much better than I am.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਗੁਣ ਮੁਝੈ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ ਕੈ ਜੀ ਦੋਸੁ ਧਰੇਹ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: se gun mujhai na aavanee kai jee dos dhareh ||4||
lines.translation: I have none of her merits or virtues; whom should I blame? ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਛਉਗੀ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee sakhee sahu raaviaa tin poochhaugee jaae ||
lines.translation: I shall go and ask those sisters who have enjoyed their Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਉ ਲੇਉਗੀ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਏ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: paai lagau benatee karau leugee pa(n)th bataae ||5||
lines.translation: I touch their feet, and ask them to show me the Path. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭਉ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukam pachhaanai naanakaa bhau cha(n)dan laavai ||
lines.translation: She who understands the Hukam of His Command, O Nanak, applies the Fear of God as her sandalwood oil;

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਣ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕਰੈ ਤਉ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਉ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: gun kaaman kaaman karai tau piaare kau paavai ||6||
lines.translation: she charms her Beloved with her virtue, and so obtains Him. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਰੇ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo dil miliaa s mil rahiaa miliaa kaheeai re soee ||
lines.translation: She who meets her Beloved in her heart, remains united with Him; this is truly called union.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਬਾਤੀ ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: je bahuteraa locheeai baatee mel na hoee ||7||
lines.translation: As much as she may long for Him, she shall not meet Him through mere words. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਿਵੈ ਕਉ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaat milai phun dhaat kau liv livai kau dhaavai ||
lines.translation: As metal melts into metal again, so does love melt into love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਤਉ ਅਨਭਉ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee jaaneeai tau anabhau paavai ||8||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, this understanding is obtained, and then, one obtains the Fearless Lord. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਨਾ ਵਾੜੀ ਹੋਇ ਘਰਿ ਖਰੁ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: paanaa vaaRee hoi ghar khar saar na jaanai ||
lines.translation: There may be an orchard of betel nut trees in the garden, but the donkey does not appreciate its value.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸੀਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਸਕ ਕਾ ਤਬ ਫੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: raseeaa hovai musak kaa tab phool pachhaanai ||9||
lines.translation: If someone savors a fragrance, then he can truly appreciate its flower. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਵੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: apiu peevai jo naanakaa bhram bhram samaavai ||
lines.translation: One who drinks in the ambrosia, O Nanak, abandons his doubts and wanderings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje sahaje mil rahai amaraa pad paavai ||10||1||
lines.translation: Easily and intuitively, he remains blended with the Lord, and obtains the immortal status. ||10||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: tila(n)g mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Tilang, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੀਤਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har keeaa kathaa kahaaneeaa gur meet sunaaeeaa ||
lines.translation: The Guru, my friend, has told me the stories and the sermon of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane gur kau bal jaaeeaa ||1||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; to the Guru, I am a sacrifice. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਮਿਲੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aai mil gurasikh aai mil too mere guroo ke piaare || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Come, join with me, O Sikh of the Guru, come and join with me. You are my Guru's Beloved. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਸੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke gun har bhaavade se guroo te paae ||
lines.translation: The Glorious Praises of the Lord are pleasing to the Lord; I have obtained them from the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਘੁਮਿ ਘੁਮਿ ਜਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jin gur kaa bhaanaa ma(n)niaa tin ghum ghum jaae ||2||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those who surrender to, and obey the Guru's Will. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin satigur piaaraa dekhiaa tin kau hau vaaree ||
lines.translation: I am dedicated and devoted to those who gaze upon the Beloved True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jin gur kee keetee chaakaree tin sad balihaaree ||3||
lines.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to those who perform service for the Guru. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har teraa naam hai dukh metanahaaraa ||
lines.translation: Your Name, O Lord, Har, Har, is the Destroyer of sorrow.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevaa te paaeeai guramukh nisataaraa ||4||
lines.translation: Serving the Guru, it is obtained, and as Gurmukh, one is emancipated. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo har naam dhiaaide te jan paravaanaa ||
lines.translation: Those humble beings who meditate on the Lord's Name, are celebrated and acclaimed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: tin vitahu naanak vaariaa sadaa sadaa kurabaanaa ||5||
lines.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice to them, forever and ever a devoted sacrifice. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa har teree usatat hai jo har prabh bhaavai ||
lines.translation: O Lord, that alone is Praise to You, which is pleasing to Your Will, O Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: jo guramukh piaaraa sevade tin har phal paavai ||6||
lines.translation: Those Gurmukhs, who serve their Beloved Lord, obtain Him as their reward. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa har setee pirahaRee tinaa jee prabh naale ||
lines.translation: Those who cherish love for the Lord, their souls are always with God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜੀਵਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: oi jap jap piaaraa jeevade har naam samaale ||7||
lines.translation: Chanting and meditating on their Beloved, they live in, and gather in, the Lord's Name. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਘੁਮਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin guramukh piaaraa seviaa tin kau ghum jaaiaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to those Gurmukhs who serve their Beloved Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਛੁਟੇ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਿਉ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਛਡਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: oi aap chhute paravaar siu sabh jagat chhadaaiaa ||8||
lines.translation: They themselves are saved, along with their families, and through them, all the world is saved. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੰਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur piaarai har seviaa gur dha(n)n gur dha(n)no ||
lines.translation: My Beloved Guru serves the Lord. Blessed is the Guru, Blessed is the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਵਡ ਪੁੰਨੋ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: gur har maarag dasiaa gur pu(n)n vad pu(n)no ||9||
lines.translation: The Guru has shown me the Lord's Path; the Guru has done the greatest good deed. ||9||
